Resolve the colour scale shared by a group of panels

Source: R/feature_plots.R
resolve_colour_scale.Rd

Resolve the colour scale shared by a group of panels

Usage

resolve_colour_scale(
  members,
  scale_features,
  min.cutoff,
  max.cutoff,
  diverging,
  center,
  cols,
  na.value,
  key
)

Arguments

members

Panels sharing the scale

scale_features

Features of these panels

min.cutoff, max.cutoff

Lists of cutoffs named by feature

diverging

Whether to use a diverging scale centred on `center`: "auto" (default) does so when the coloured values span `center`, or TRUE / FALSE

center

Centre of a diverging scale, default is 0. The two sides of the scale extend equally far in colour from the centre, so that a side with a smaller range does not reach its darkest colour

cols

The colours of the scale. If NULL (default), "plasma_r" or, for a diverging scale, "blue-magenta". Otherwise two or more colours from low to high values, e.g. `c("grey90", "darkred")` (low, high) or, for a diverging scale, `c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")` (low, centre, high); or the name of a sequential or diverging palette (see show_palettes), such as "viridis", "magma" or "tol-burd", or of an RColorBrewer palette

na.value

Colour of cells (or tiles) that are not coloured. If NULL (default), "grey88", or "grey70" for a diverging scale so that they stand out from its light centre

key

Name of the scale, for messages

Value

A list with the colour `limits`, `colours`, `rescaler`, `na.value` and whether it is `diverging`
